# Dropzone

> Composable file intake with validation, managed selection, and drag-activated overlays.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `dropzone` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/dropzone.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/dropzone.md`.

## Composition

### File intake

```tsx
<Dropzone>
  <DropzoneInput />
  <DropzoneArea>
    <DropzoneTrigger />
    <DropzoneOverlay />
  </DropzoneArea>
  <DropzoneFileList>
    file render callback
      file content
      <DropzoneRemove />
  </DropzoneFileList>
  <DropzoneRejectionList>
    custom rejection row
      <DropzoneRejectionRemove />
  </DropzoneRejectionList>
  <DropzoneStatus />
  <DropzoneClear />
</Dropzone>
```

### Compact drop bar

Dropzone size="sm" renders the trigger as one control-height row with start-aligned content, for an attachment bar inside a composer or form. A host that uploads on arrival reads acceptedFiles in onDrop and renders its own previews instead of DropzoneFileList.

```tsx
<Dropzone>
  <DropzoneInput />
  <DropzoneArea>
    <DropzoneTrigger>
      icon and label
    </DropzoneTrigger>
    <DropzoneOverlay />
  </DropzoneArea>
</Dropzone>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

import {
  Dropzone,
  DropzoneArea,
  DropzoneClear,
  DropzoneFileList,
  DropzoneInput,
  type DropzonePolicy,
  DropzoneRejectionList,
  DropzoneStatus,
  DropzoneTrigger,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/dropzone";

const documentPolicy: DropzonePolicy = {
  accept: {
    "image/png": [".png"],
    "image/jpeg": [".jpg", ".jpeg"],
    "image/webp": [".webp"],
    "application/pdf": [".pdf"],
  },
  maxSize: 5_000_000,
  maxFiles: 4,
};

const triggerMessages = {
  idle: "Drop up to 4 images or PDFs, or choose files",
  accept: "Release to add these files",
  reject: "Only PNG, JPEG, WebP, and PDF files up to 5 MB",
};

export function PrimitiveDropzoneExample() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<readonly File[]>([]);

  return (
    <Dropzone value={files} onValueChange={(nextFiles) => setFiles(nextFiles)} policy={documentPolicy} className="w-full max-w-xl">
      <DropzoneInput />
      <DropzoneArea>
        <DropzoneTrigger messages={triggerMessages} />
      </DropzoneArea>
      <DropzoneFileList />
      <DropzoneRejectionList />
      <div className="mt-3">
        <DropzoneClear />
      </div>
      <DropzoneStatus />
    </Dropzone>
  );
}
```
